I am particularly fascinated by malware internals and reverse engineering, studying how malicious software operates to better understand detection, incident response, and defensive strategies.Beyond research, I actively participate in hackathons, Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, and the cybersecurity community. These experiences continually challenge me to learn new techniques, collaborate with talented professionals, and apply security concepts to real-world scenarios.I believe cybersecurity is a field of continuous learning. Staying curious, sharing knowledge, and constantly adapting to new technologies and threats are essential to building a safer digital ecosystem. My goal is to keep pushing my technical boundaries while contributing meaningful research, innovative security solutions, and practical tools to the cybersecurity community.
